# Wobo

> Wobo is an AI tutor for Indian school students that draws every explanation live on the page, for every subject their board sets.

Wobo is made by Dot eVentures Pvt Ltd in Hyderabad, India. Every page listed below is public
and readable without an account. Everything else on this site is a signed-in learner’s own
work and is not published.

## Pages

- [Wobo](https://heywobo.com/): What Wobo is, and one question answered four ways.
- [Meet Wobo](https://heywobo.com/meet-wobo): The tutor itself: how it draws, speaks and reads a page.
- [How Wobo works](https://heywobo.com/how-it-works): What happens in a lesson, step by step.
- [Subjects](https://heywobo.com/subjects): The boards, the classes and the subjects Wobo covers.
- [For parents](https://heywobo.com/for-parents): What a parent sees, and what Wobo will not do.
- [For students](https://heywobo.com/for-students): What a learner gets, and what it costs them.
- [Plans](https://heywobo.com/plans): Free every day, and what a paid plan buys.
- [Security and trust](https://heywobo.com/security): How the product is built, and what it does with data.
- [Help centre](https://heywobo.com/help): One article per question a learner or a parent asks.
- [Legal](https://heywobo.com/legal): Every legal document, each in plain words first.
- [Blog](https://heywobo.com/blog): What we are building, and what we are learning.
- [About](https://heywobo.com/about): Who makes Wobo, and why.
- [Contact](https://heywobo.com/contact): How to reach a person here.
- [Gift](https://heywobo.com/gift): Buying a place for someone else.
- [Donate](https://heywobo.com/donate): Paying for a place for a family who cannot.
